slides.headline: Pricing on what you need
slides.body: Buyers pay what the market supports, not what your bond needs.

slides.headline: Testing the market high
slides.body: Overpriced homes sit. Then buyers start asking what's wrong with them.

slides.headline: Using old sales
slides.body: What sold two years ago says little about today's buyers.

slides.headline: Ignoring the competition
slides.body: Buyers compare your home with everything else for sale in your suburb.

slides.headline: Pricing what you spent
slides.body: Renovations add appeal, but rarely add value rand for rand.

slides.headline: Want your real number?
slides.body: I'll compare recent sales around you. Free, no obligation.
